name: Ambition
description: Drive for success, status, and high achievement.

name: Discipline
description: Focus, work ethic, and resistance to distraction.

name: Risk Tolerance
description: Willingness to take bold or uncertain actions.

name: Empathy
description: Sensitivity to feelings and perspectives of others.

name: Resilience
description: Ability to bounce back quickly from failure or loss.

name: Creativity
description: Original thinking and lateral problem solving.

name: Sociability
description: Extroversion and energy gained from social interaction.
